strategy.primary: Sacrifice card-draw aristocrats: build cheap repeatable fodder, resolve Tresserhorn while paying his three-creature ETB (three draw triggers), then turn every sacrifice into a card and close with drain payoffs or loops (The Locust God + a free outlet, Gravecrawler + Phyrexian Altar or Plunderer).
strategy.secondary: The 10/4 trample, indestructible commander as a combat threat with Infantry Shield, Wand of Orcus, My Precious and Chandra's Ignition.

commander_oracle_snapshots.name: Tresserhorn's Lord, Returned
commander_oracle_snapshots.oracle_text:
Trample, indestructible
When Tresserhorn's Lord enters, sacrifice him unless you sacrifice three creatures, pay 3 life, and have target opponent draw three cards.
Whenever you sacrifice a creature, draw a card.

future_release.official_commander_legality: not legal until 2026-11-13 (Wizards: new-to-Magic MBC cards are legal from 2026-11-13)
